### Correcting the Day of Life at Admission {#sec-solution-18}

The day of life on the infection and procedure forms of an enrolment is calculated from the day of life at admission recorded on its admission form, so a wrong value there makes the day of life on those forms wrong too.
For an infant admitted from the delivery room or on the day of birth, the platform sets the day of life at admission to 1 itself, but only while the admission form is open for editing; a completed admission form, or one in a completed enrolment, keeps its stored value until it is reopened for editing.
The validation report already uses day of life 1 at admission for such an infant in its calculations, so the values it shows can differ from those on the forms until the forms are corrected.
If the admission form of such an infant records another day of life at admission, reopen it for editing (see @sec-solution-9); reopening it makes the platform set the value to 1 at once.
Check that the form now shows 1 and complete it again (see @sec-solution-8).
Then, for each infection and procedure form of the enrolment, reopen it for editing if it is completed (see @sec-solution-9), refresh the page as described in @sec-solution-11 so that the platform calculates the form's day of life again, and complete it again if it was completed (see @sec-solution-8).
If you reopened the enrolment to edit its forms, complete it again as well (see @sec-solution-4).
